widgets_values:
MiniMax H3
MiniMax H3 是 MiniMax 推出的通用多模态生成模型。该模型可同时理解文本、图像、视频与音频，能够生成自带原生立体音频的视频：人声、音效、音乐在单次前向运算中统一建模，而非后期分层叠加输出。输出视频最高支持 2K 分辨率、24 帧每秒，时长最长约 15 秒。

关于该工作流
该模板借助 MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo 节点执行参考图生成视频（ref2va）任务。它支持混合导入参考图像、参考视频以及独立音频素材，并将素材融入生成过程，用以锁定人物形象、画面风格、动作、镜头运镜或是人声。
核心输入项
・ref_images /ref_videos/ref_video_audios /ref_audios：最多支持 9 张参考图像、3 段参考视频（每段视频可附带配套音轨）以及 3 段独立参考音频片段
・prompt：通过标签引用输入素材，顺序与连线接入顺序保持一致，例如 <图片 1>、< 视频 1>、< 音频 1>，随后描述目标场景、动作以及音频内容
・ref_image_size：缩放参考素材至生成分辨率（运算速度更快）；max 模式可保留最短边最高 2048 像素，获得更高形象还原度，但会降低运算速度，参考特征会参与每一步采样运算
・width /height：通过分辨率选择器设置
・duration（秒）：由数学表达式节点换算为有效总帧数
采样与解码
・采样器：res_multistep。对于这类大量引用参考素材的提示词，beta 调度器或 normal 调度器效果通常优于 simple 调度器
・采样器输出融合音视频的隐空间数据，直接同时送入 VAEDecode（视频解码器，minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16）与 VAEDecodeAudio（音频解码器，minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32）；两个解码节点会自动从打包隐变量中分离各自所需数据。随后 CreateVideo 将音视频合成封装为音画同步的单个 MP4 文件
・本工作流使用的扩散模型权重文件为 minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors，和文生视频 / 图生视频模板所使用的 fl2va 模型权重不同
参考生成视频（ref2va）的生成结果对提示词措辞十分敏感；精准使用参考素材标签，清晰指定每份参考素材负责画面哪一部分，通常能取得最佳效果。

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the same adult female fashion model shown across <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, and <Picture 3>, with a consistent recognizable face, long straight brown hair, natural makeup, a gentle expression, and a beige-brown cap.
<Subject 2> is the exact outfit worn by <Subject 1> across all three pictures: a white crinkled long-sleeve blouse with puffed shoulders, front ruffles, floral fabric detail, long white ties, and flared cuffs; dark olive-green high-waist suspender shorts with two straps, front buttons, pockets, and rolled hems; and brown knee-high boots.
<Subject 3> is the quiet cream-toned French vintage interior shared by all three pictures, with soft morning window light, pale plaster walls, restrained light wood, linen textures, and a low-saturation ivory, olive, and warm-brown palette.
<Picture 1> is the opening composition anchor for [Shot 1], defining the garment-first medium-long framing and morning-light reveal.
<Picture 2> is the motion keyframe for [Shot 2] and [Shot 3], defining the gentle walking posture, full-outfit visibility, and natural movement of the sleeves and blouse ties.
<Picture 3> is the final-frame anchor for [Shot 5], defining the complete-outfit pose, negative space, typography, and exact visible Chinese copy.

summary:
[reference generation + keyframe completion] A 15-second vertical French-vintage fashion film keeps <Subject 1>, <Subject 2>, and <Subject 3> fully consistent while moving from the garment-first reveal of <Picture 1>, through the restrained walking and turning motion of <Picture 2>, to the stable final composition and exact Chinese copy of <Picture 3>. The clothing remains the primary visual subject; the model's face supports identity continuity but never becomes a prolonged portrait close-up.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - the same face, hair, cap, natural makeup, body proportions, and restrained expression remain consistent.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - the blouse construction, ruffles, ties, sleeves, olive suspenders, waistline, buttons, pockets, shorts hems, boots, colors, and materials remain unchanged.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - the cream room, soft window light, pale textures, and low-saturation French editorial atmosphere continue throughout.
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] opening composition): fully_preserved - its garment-first viewpoint, subject placement, and soft morning-light direction establish the video.
<Picture 2> ([Shot 2] motion keyframe and [Shot 3] movement guide): fully_preserved - its gentle step, full-outfit clarity, and subtle fabric movement guide the central action.
<Picture 3> ([Shot 5] final frame): fully_preserved - its stable full-body composition, negative space, typography, and exact copy are retained.

detailed_description:
The target video uses realistic French editorial fashion photography in a vertical 9:16 frame, with soft morning light, subtle warm-gray film grain, restrained movement, and no dialogue. Clothing is always the first visual priority.

[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1> inside <Subject 3>. A garment-first medium view frames <Subject 1> from the chest through the high waist, clearly showing <Subject 2>'s white crinkled blouse, layered ruffles, floral detail, long ties, two olive suspenders, front buttons, and structured waist. The camera makes a slow, smooth pullback to a medium-long composition over three seconds, revealing more of the shorts and sleeves while the window light moves gently across the fabric texture. Her face remains recognizable near the upper third but is not emphasized. She breathes naturally and keeps a relaxed posture; no copy is visible.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the composition flows toward <Picture 2>. <Subject 1> takes two slow, graceful steps forward as the camera tracks laterally at waist-to-chest height. The movement is calm rather than theatrical. The blouse ties and flared cuffs drift lightly in the indoor breeze, while the olive waist, both suspenders, buttons, pockets, shorts hems, and brown boots remain sharp and structurally stable. The camera briefly decelerates after the second step so the complete silhouette can be read.

[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, <Subject 1> makes one restrained quarter turn. The camera performs a soft half-orbit following the line from her shoulder down through the suspenders and fitted waist, reaches a clean three-quarter side view, then returns toward the front. Do not spin rapidly, show her back for long, crop the garment, or move toward a face close-up. The action reveals how <Subject 2> sits on the body while preserving the exact outfit geometry and colors from <Picture 2>.

[Shot 4] At 00:09.000, cut to a concise garment-detail sequence within the same continuous light. First, a close medium view shows her fingers naturally smoothing one flared cuff; then the camera slides across the blouse's crinkled weave, front ruffles, long tie, olive strap edge, metal buttons, and high waist. These details occupy no more than two seconds before the camera eases back to a balanced medium-full view. Her hand remains anatomically natural and never covers the main construction.

[Shot 5] At 00:12.000, the shot settles into <Picture 3>. <Subject 1> stops in a relaxed complete-outfit pose, both boots visible, and gives one subtle natural glance toward the camera. Preserve clean upper-left negative space and display exactly one single line of Simplified Chinese text: “轻盈，自有姿态”. Match <Picture 3>'s clean modern sans-serif, warm-charcoal color, size, spacing, and placement. Hold the final composition perfectly steady until 00:15.000. No English, subtitle, brand mark, price, additional text, other person, extra garment, outfit change, watermark, interface, or duplicated body part appears.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet cream-room ambience continues throughout, with a faint morning breeze near the window, soft fabric rustle synchronized to the sleeves and blouse ties, two restrained footsteps during [Shot 2], and a delicate cuff-and-fabric touch in [Shot 4]. Keep all physical sounds intimate, clean, and natural, with no voice-over or dialogue.

non_diegetic_music:
A gentle French-vintage instrumental at approximately 84 BPM uses warm nylon-string guitar, a very restrained accordion breath, soft brushed percussion, and rounded acoustic bass. The arrangement opens sparsely, adds a light pulse during the walking and turn, becomes nearly weightless during the garment details, and resolves into a calm sustained chord for the final copy hold. No vocals, no dramatic swell, no upbeat commercial jingle, and no electronic drop.
